verdict.rationale: Honeycomb ships AI features such as Query Assistant, so it is fair to ask whether it can consume external MCP servers. However, every MCP item in the evidence describes Honeycomb acting as an MCP server that external agents connect to. Nothing shows Honeycomb plugging in third-party MCP servers to use their tools, and server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
